scope: Local native saved-view authoring and retained receipts; no live tests or deployment

checks.name: Release application and all three Worker dry builds
Changed prose, strict future, repository consistency and whitespace

acceptance_evidence: SavedTaskView appends native kind 5. Create requires complete query and name; rename retains query, complete replacement removes old predicates and archive retains the last definition and every original receipt.

Native v2 identity binds exact source and fixed ordered scalar predicates. JSON property order does not affect semantic identity/equality; older kind commands retain v1 hash fixtures and unused Query serialization.
Atomic document/native history changes preserve all tasks, mappings, completion/restoration/Habit/occurrence history, task commands and activity events. No game entry or effect is created.

Both runtimes reject incompatible fields/kinds, missing or invalid query, unknown references, duplicate entity identities, stale revisions and archived fresh edits. Retained archived organization filter references remain valid.

Typed history and journal validation reject altered query snapshots, hashes and effect fields. Original retries recover exact earlier query receipts after replacement/archive and acknowledgement loss; changed intent fails identity reuse.
limitations: Scoped transport and browser query validation remain the next unit.
Relative presets, reminders, production UI and real host/device/account qualification remain separate.
